summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter in the repository, per the spec. Changes: rich/tree.py (Tree.__rich_measure__, iterative depth-first walk with four-cell indentation per level; Measurement import); rich/align.py (Align.__repr__, Align rendering constrains the wrapped renderable to its measured maximum, or the smaller of that and an explicit width; new VerticalCenter class with rendering, measurement, and repr); rich/console.py (print passes justify="default" into render options for collected renderables; justify still goes into collection); CHANGELOG.md (9.8.0 marked "- Unreleased" with an Added subheading and two entries; existing entry kept); tests/test_align.py and tests/test_tree.py (new tests for reprs, VerticalCenter rendering and measurement, centered tree under Align, and the acceptance tree measuring (11, 19)). Caveat: per instructions I did not run the tests or any repository code, so all changes were verified by reading only. Nothing was committed.
